examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

заниматься.gloss: to be busy with, to do

meanings.en: to do, to be engaged in
meanings.note: + instrumental: заниматься бизнесом = be in business

related.gloss: to take up, to attend to (pf)

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

meanings.note: mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.

examples.text: Нина, имей совесть! Я вчера ради вас всё сделал.
examples.trans: Nina, have a heart! Yesterday I did everything for you.

meanings.note: For movement; где is for location.

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: We are walking in the park.

meanings.en: to prompt, to tell, to inform
meanings.note: to provide helpful information or prompt someone

examples.trans: Could you tell me, please, where the exit is?

examples.text: Подскажите, пожалуйста, какая у него порода?
examples.trans: Could you tell me, please, what breed he is?
Could you tell me where the restroom is located?

meanings.note: Вы уж нас извините = do forgive us.

examples.text: Ты уж не сердись на меня.
examples.trans: Please don't be angry with me.

examples.text: Поймите, была маленькая ошибка. Вы уж нас извините.
examples.trans: Understand, there was a small mistake. Please forgive us.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
